connector.name: OpenAI Tools MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Focused MCP server for OpenAI image/audio generation (v2.0.0). Wraps endpoints via HAPI CLI.
connector.summary: Hosted at openai-tools.run.mcp.com.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.com.mcp. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token for authenticating with the OpenAI API. Obtain via the OpenAI dashboard. https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
